data: What is the approximate performance (F1) of the model adapted from NewsQA with 80,000 source training data?

The figure shows two lines representing the F1 performance of the proposed model adapted from SQuAD and NewsQA. The red line represents the performance for SQuAD, while the blue line represents the performance for NewsQA. The x-axis represents the number of RC instances, and the y-axis represents the F1 performance.

To find the approximate performance of the model adapted from NewsQA with 80,000 source training data, we need to look at the blue line and find its value when the x-axis is approximately 80,000. From the figure, it appears that the blue line reaches an F1 performance of around 32.5 when the x-axis is approximately 80,000.
Therefore, the approximate performance (F1) of the model adapted from NewsQA with 80,000 source training data is 32.5.
